## Security Checklist

- [ ] OrangLauncher updated to latest version
- [ ] System OS updated with security patches
- [ ] No unknown plugins installed
- [ ] Only mods from trusted sources (Modrinth/CurseForge)
- [ ] Backups created of important saves
- [ ] I have log file that i can provide or tried running program on terminal
- [ ] Telemetry disabled (if privacy sensitive)
